workspace.title: Root workspace uses Turbo and Yarn PnP
workspace.test: The repository root must be a private Turbo monorepo using Yarn Plug'n'Play workspaces for apps and packages.

steps.instruction: Inspect package.json, .yarnrc.yml, turbo.json, tsconfig.json, and tsconfig.base.json.
steps.expected: Root package.json is private, declares apps/* and packages/* workspaces, has turbo-backed build/test/deploy scripts, .yarnrc.yml uses pnp, turbo.json exists, and root tsconfig references workspace projects.

steps.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable and yarn build.
steps.expected: Both commands complete successfully without creating node_modules.

workspace.passCriteria: The root workspace contract is implemented and buildable through Turbo.

packages.title: Domain package owns ndx logic
packages.test: The ndx domain implementation must live under packages/ndx and expose stable subpath exports.

steps.expected: The package is named @neurondev/ndx-core and contains cli, server, dashboard, config, model, agent, runtime, process, tools, and shared source folders.
The package exports ., ./cli, ./server, ./dashboard, and ./shared from dist files.

packages.passCriteria: packages/ndx is the domain package and exposes the planned public subpaths.

packages.title: Dependencies remain app-to-package and acyclic
packages.test: Apps may depend on packages, but packages must not depend on apps. packages/ndx internal source must not create the previous session-runtime-agent-session cycle.

steps.instruction: Search packages for imports from apps and inspect app package dependencies.
steps.expected: No package source imports apps/*, and app packages depend on @neurondev/ndx-core.

steps.instruction: Inspect imports among packages/ndx/src/server, runtime, agent, and tools.
steps.expected: runtime does not import agent, agent does not import server/session, and the old session -> runtime -> agent -> session cycle is absent.

packages.passCriteria: The dependency direction rule is enforced by observable imports and package manifests.

apps.title: Apps are thin wrappers and preserve bins
apps.test: apps/ndx and apps/ndxserver must be thin wrappers over @neurondev/ndx-core while @neurondev/ndx still publishes ndx and ndxserver bins.

steps.instruction: Inspect apps/ndx and apps/ndxserver source files.
steps.expected: App sources only import @neurondev/ndx-core subpaths and invoke exported entrypoints; they do not contain argument parsing, config loading, session orchestration, dashboard rendering, or Docker sandbox logic.

steps.instruction: Build the workspace, then run apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndx.js --version and apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndxserver.js --version.
steps.expected: Both commands print the package version and exit successfully.

steps.instruction: Run yarn workspace @neurondev/ndx pack --dry-run and inspect the package files.
steps.expected: The publish package includes compiled bin files for ndx and ndxserver and compiled app files, without source-only dependency on the root src folder.

apps.passCriteria: @neurondev/ndx remains install-compatible and apps stay orchestration-only.

apps.title: Toolcontainer owns sandbox image
apps.test: The sandbox Dockerfile must live under apps/toolcontainer and compose must build from that app.

steps.expected: docker-compose.yml builds ndx-sandbox from apps/toolcontainer and the Dockerfile preserves the existing sandbox runtime packages and apply_patch helper.

apps.passCriteria: The Docker sandbox is represented as an app without changing the sandbox contract.

documentation.title: Docs describe the monorepo contract
documentation.test: Root and package documentation must describe the monorepo layout, public interfaces, dependency rules, and test/deploy process.

steps.instruction: Inspect README.md and docs/overview.md, architecture.md, api.md, usage.md, constraints.md, internals.md, and testing.md.
steps.expected: The docs describe apps/ndx, apps/ndxserver, apps/toolcontainer, packages/ndx, Turbo build, bin compatibility, dependency direction, and agenttest/deploy verification.
packages/ndx has README.md plus docs/overview.md, architecture.md, api.md, usage.md, constraints.md, internals.md, and testing.md.

documentation.passCriteria: Documentation matches the implemented monorepo and package contracts.

deploy.title: Deploy verifies build and sandbox
deploy.test: The final deploy path must build the monorepo, run the policy test hook, refresh Docker compose, verify sandbox write, and tear down compose.

steps.expected: The deploy command completes successfully and its output includes Turbo build execution, Docker compose down, compose build, compose up, sandbox write verification, and final compose down.

deploy.passCriteria: npm run deploy completes the full repository verification contract.
